name: Roronoa Zoro — Wano
description: Stationary Straw Hat melee-area specialist using Wado Ichimonji, Sandai Kitetsu and Enma. Continuity is the original manga through Wano and excludes anime-only material. All costs, distances, timings and damage are authored adaptations. Oni Giri adapts a stationary three-sword area cut; Ashura adapts one offensive manifestation and does not summon independent fighters. Foxfire flame cutting, projectile interception, defensive endurance, wandering, flying slashes and terrain destruction are omitted rather than renamed as damage effects. Armor ignore is personal and does not debuff enemies or buff allies; Haki never bypasses invulnerability. The unit uses one base profile and one stamina-draining King of Hell form. Stamina, form changes and Techniques follow the runtime lifecycle rules. Techniques queue for the next primary cycle, lock target, form and Technique, recheck eligibility and funding, and share one cooldown. Purchases are cumulative across three paths; legal purchases use no more than two paths, with the smaller at most tier 2. No healing, income, companions or ally buffs are provided.

techniques.name: One Sword Style Iai: Shishi Sonson

forms.name: King of Hell Three Sword Style

paths.name: Three Sword Mastery
paths.description: Improves Zoro's sustained melee-area damage, reach and primary execution. These purchases do not create parallel attacks. Tier 3 unlocks stamina and Shishi Sonson; tier 5 unlocks Ashura and King of Hell.

upgrades.name: Three-Blade Coordination
upgrades.description: Add 4 damage to primary attacks and all Techniques before purchased damage multipliers.

upgrades.name: Extended Cutting Reach
upgrades.description: Add 0.5 primary reach, expanding reach available to Techniques and eligible melee collateral.

upgrades.name: Nigori-Zake Strength
upgrades.description: Multiply primary and Technique damage by 1.25.

upgrades.name: Rapid Three-Sword Execution
upgrades.description: Multiply primary windup and period by 0.8. Technique timing and shared cooldown are unchanged.

upgrades.name: Onigashima Cutting Power
upgrades.description: Multiply primary and Technique damage by another 1.4 and add 0.5 reach.

paths.name: Steel-Cutting Armament
paths.description: Personal anti-armor specialization adapted from Zoro's steel-cutting swordsmanship and Armament Haki. Armor ignore affects this unit's ordinary damage only and does not alter enemy armor for allies.

upgrades.name: Breath of Steel
upgrades.description: Ignore 15% of armor on primary and Technique damage; conditional value against armored enemies.

upgrades.name: Armament Imbuement
upgrades.description: Raise armor ignore to 30% and add 2 damage to primary attacks and all Techniques.

upgrades.name: Hardened Blades
upgrades.description: Raise armor ignore to 45% and multiply primary and Technique damage by 1.1.

upgrades.name: Enma Control
upgrades.description: Raise armor ignore to 65% and add 6 damage to primary attacks and all Techniques. It does not refill or enlarge stamina.

upgrades.name: Supreme King Infusion
upgrades.description: Raise armor ignore to 80% and multiply primary and Technique damage by another 1.3. This is not permanent armor destruction.

paths.name: Perception and Presence
paths.description: Observation Haki improves target acquisition, while Supreme King Haki is adapted as a limited pulse against eligible weaker opponents. Pulse stuns require weakWilled and stunnable; existing stun and its following protection interval block new stuns.

upgrades.name: Observation Haki
upgrades.description: Enable concealed-target detection. Obstacles and invulnerability remain separate eligibility checks.

upgrades.name: Read the Opening
upgrades.description: Enable one primary retarget at resolution if the original target is lost, without restarting windup. Techniques never retarget.

upgrades.name: Intimidating Presence
upgrades.description: Every 4 successful primary contacts can trigger a damage-free pulse with radius 3.5, cap 4, 0.6-second stun and a 6-second minimum interval.

upgrades.name: Overwhelming Killing Intent
upgrades.description: Replace the pulse with a 3-contact threshold, radius 4, cap 6, 0.9-second stun and 5-second minimum interval.

upgrades.name: Conqueror's Presence
upgrades.description: Replace the pulse with a 2-contact threshold, radius 4.5, cap 8, 1.2-second stun and 4-second minimum interval. Also multiply primary timing by 0.9; Techniques remain unchanged.
